x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Opener Tool - quickly open links, paths, stored data, and REST shortcuts.

Examples:
  o list
  o list -s github
  o add jira "https://jira.company.com/browse/{0}" -t WebPath
  o jira PROJ-123
  o jira -s    # search for keys containing 'jira' and execute if single match
  o githubtoken -r  # print token to stdout instead of copying
  o githubtoken -c  # force copy token to clipboard instead of opening
  o add api "https://nvidia<env>.domain.com/<region>/<user>" -t WebPath --url-aliases '{ "env": { "d": "-dev", "p": "" } }' --default-params '{ "user": "kchirravuri" }'
  o api env=d region=us

options.name: --type
options.description: Key type: WebPath, LocalPath, Data, JsonData, or Rest. [default: Data]

options.name: --url-aliases
options.description: Per-key alias map JSON. Inline JSON or a JSON file path. Shape: { "placeholder": { "input": "replacement" } }. Example file content: { "env": { "d": "-dev", "u": "-uat", "p": "" } }

options.name: --default-params
options.description: Per-key default params JSON. Inline JSON or a JSON file path. Shape: { "placeholder": "defaultValue" }. Example file content: { "user": "krishna", "region": "us" }

options.name: --elevated
options.description: Execute the key in elevated mode (admin/sudo)

arguments.name: key
arguments.description: Unique key name, for example jira or api.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Stored value. Meaning depends on --type: URL template, local path, data, JSON, or REST JSON.

options.name: --return
options.description: Return the resolved value to stdout instead of copying/opening

options.name: --copy
options.description: Force copy the resolved value to clipboard instead of performing the default action

options.name: --search
options.description: Treat the provided key as a search term and lookup by substring (key + description)

options.name: --elevated
options.description: Execute the command/script in elevated mode (admin/sudo)

options.name: --view
options.description: View the raw details and stored value of the key
